synthesis.unconverted: Accounts and flows in {currencies} have no exchange rate for their date: they are left out of the figures that need one. Enter a rate on the currencies page.
synthesis.empty: Nothing to show yet. Add an account on the <link>accounts page</link> first.

currencies.title: Currencies and exchange rates
currencies.referenceIntro: Totals and the monthly synthesis are expressed in this currency. Accounts in another currency are converted with the exchange rates below.
currencies.referenceLabel: Reference currency (ISO 4217 code, for example EUR)
currencies.ratesIntro: One unit of the base currency is worth the rate in the quote currency. A rate applies from its date until a more recent one is entered, in either direction of the pair. A currency without a rate is left out of the figures that need one, and reported.
currencies.caption: Recorded exchange rates, by currency pair then date
currencies.deleteMessage: Totals will no longer use this rate.
currencies.ecbIntro: Disabled by default, so that Demain makes no outbound call. When enabled, the button below sends one request to ecb.europa.eu for the daily reference rates against the euro. Nothing about you or your accounts is sent. A rate you entered by hand for the same day is kept. Nothing is fetched automatically.

imports.title: Import a bank statement
imports.intro: Import a CSV or OFX file exported by your bank. The file is read on this server and goes nowhere else. Importing the same file twice adds nothing.

backup.title: Backup and export
backup.intro: Demain keeps everything in one SQLite file on this server. Keep copies of it somewhere else, and check that you can restore them.
backup.snapshotIntro: A consistent copy of the whole database, taken while the app is running and encrypted with a password you choose. It is the file to keep off-site and the only one you can restore from. If you lose the password, nobody can open the snapshot.
backup.snapshotDone: Snapshot downloaded. Store it away from this server.
backup.jsonIntro: A readable copy of your data (accounts, transactions, categories, rules, balances and exchange rates) to inspect it or to leave Demain. The format is documented and versioned. Your sign-in credentials are not included. It cannot be restored: use a snapshot for that.
backup.jsonWarning: Warning: without a password, this file is not encrypted. Anyone who gets it can read your finances.
backup.restoreWarning: Warning: restoring replaces everything in Demain, your account and password included, with the content of the snapshot. What is replaced is kept as before-restore.db in the data folder until the next restore. You are signed out afterwards.
backup.restoreConfirmMessage: Everything in Demain is replaced by the content of the snapshot, your account and password included, and you are signed out. What is replaced is kept as before-restore.db in the data folder.
backup.failed: The file could not be prepared. Check your connection and try again.
